title: The problem
caption: A nurse asks “Who should we call?”, the answer sits blurred inside the blank of “Call my ____”, and in the first five seconds a press gets only a knock and “Nothing. The word won’t come.”

title: Two choices, one sentence
caption: The scan has entered the starters row and lights “I feel…”, where the Next tag points, while the goal asks for “I feel pain. I need medicine.” and the rows not in play fade.

title: Only the words that fit
caption: “I feel…” has opened a blank, “I feel ____”, and the scan has jumped straight to the feelings: the first words row is entered and “Pain” is lit.

title: Find a word: describe it
caption: “Wife” is not on the board, so after “Call my…” the person describes her: Find a word › A person › Family asks “Which generation?” and “My generation” is lit.

title: Find a word: recognise it
caption: Four people to recognise, each with a first-letter cue and the sentence it will say; “Wife” is lit, and choosing it adds “Please call my wife.” to the open blank.

title: Hear it in Ukrainian
caption: The person’s three sentences replay in Ukrainian, each card showing starter + word above the stored sentence, with Continue lit; the page scrolls on this iPad, so the third sentence, «Подзвоніть, будь ласка, моїй дружині.», starts just below the fold.

title: A voice that offers the word
caption: Who Holos is for and why it is free, private and open source, with “Keep talking” lit to open the board for free use.

title: The board on iPhone
caption: The same board on an iPhone in portrait, mid-scan: “I feel pain.” is built, “I need ____” waits, and “Medicine” is lit in a row of small cells whose labels shrink, or truncate, to fit.
